# Enterprise Payment Solutions

Built for enterprise growth, without enterprise billing complexity

Paddle manages payments, billing, global tax, and compliance for large SaaS and app companies so expansion doesn't slow growth. Trusted by Sony, P&G and ServiceNow.

[Book a demo](https://www.paddle.com/demo) [Get started](https://login.paddle.com/signup)

## Take on new markets, not new tax burden

Expanding globally shouldn’t mean adding new tax registrations, local compliance workflows and audit risk to your team’s workload. As your Merchant of Record, Paddle manages sales tax, VAT and GST obligations across markets, helping you enter new regions and jurisdictions without building additional tax infrastructure.

![Billing tax compliance](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aiBzVQeQX7-eWq9f_billing-feature-tax-compliance-hero.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=3840)

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXv0MqNJQqH0YC_icon-hourglass.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=32)

##### End-to-end tax handling

Paddle handles tax Sales tax, VAT, GST managed globally, from registration, calculation, collection, filing and remittance across supported jurisdictions in 300+ markets and territories.

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXvkMqNJQqH0YB_icon-checklist.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

##### Built for B2B scale

Reverse charge is applied automatically when eligible B2B customers provide a valid VAT ID at checkout

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXwEMqNJQqH0YD_icon-protection.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

##### Be audit ready

Consolidated tax records across markets give your finance team clearer visibility and a stronger audit trail for every due diligence and IPO

![](https://paddle.cdn.prismic.io/paddle/Eii4hsF-Cl86WnbR_midmarket2.svg?fit=max&w=256)![g2 fastest implementation subscription billing software](https://paddle.cdn.prismic.io/paddle/aPfEwbpReVYa3iQo_g2-implementation-widget.svg?fit=max&w=256)![](https://paddle.cdn.prismic.io/paddle/bGbi4EjBt5ymn-Th_midmarket1.svg?fit=max&w=256)

## Reduce billing complexity and total cost of ownership

As your business grows, every extra provider adds more than another contract.

Paddle brings payments, billing, tax, compliance, fraud, retention and reporting into one Merchant of Record platform - helping your teams reduce total cost of ownership without sacrificing the capabilities they need to grow.

![Billing investment UI](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aiBzhgeQX7-eWq9h_billing-feature-investment.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=3840)

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXv0MqNJQqH0YC_icon-hourglass.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=32)

Consolidate multiple vendors and workflows into one platform

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXvkMqNJQqH0YB_icon-checklist.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

Reduce integration, reconciliation and maintenance effort across teams

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXwEMqNJQqH0YD_icon-protection.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

Give Finance, Product and Engineering one clearer operating model for global revenue.

![Table Background](https://www.paddle.com/_next/static/media/table-bg.0utpo8exi84sd.svg?dpl=3937f0e13cc7b317f33e82899bfed8d34f3e153aba38c7d2d3e50da5644bdfc0366166316633323939363731313564346437613735333266)

# Compare Paddle vs PSPs

|  | **PSP** | **Merchant of Record (Paddle)** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Payments** | Handled | Handled |
| **Tax** | You manage | Handled |
| **Compliance** | You manage | Handled |
| **Billing** | Separate setup | Included |
| **Setup** | Multiple systems | One system |

## Increase payment acceptance across markets

Payment performance varies by region, payment method, and bank. A single gateway can cause legitimate payments to fail.

Paddle routes each transaction across multiple gateways to help more payments succeed and increase completed revenue.

![Billing payments router](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aiBy4weQX7-eWq9c_billing-feature-payments-router.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=3840)

Maximize acceptance rates with payment routing across 5+ gateways

Increase conversion with localized payment methods and currencies across 175+ countries, so buyers can pay the way they expect

Unlock higher approval rates through local acquiring

Reduce cost

## Reduce chargeback risk and recover more revenue

Chargebacks drain revenue, add operational work and can put pressure on your payment relationships.

As your Merchant of Record, Paddle helps manage chargeback risk with early warning signals, proactive refunding where appropriate, and clearer reporting on chargeback activity, rates and outcomes.

![Billing fraud network](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aiB5OQeQX7-eWq_L_billing-feature-fraud-network.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=3840)

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXv0MqNJQqH0YC_icon-hourglass.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=32)

Keep chargeback rates under control with early warning signals and proactive interventions

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXvkMqNJQqH0YB_icon-checklist.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

See Paddle’s dispute management in action, with clear reporting on defended disputes, win rates and early warning outcomes

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXwEMqNJQqH0YD_icon-protection.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

Recover more revenue with built-in failed payment recovery, smart retries, dunning and churn prevention tools

## Close enterprise deals without rebuilding your billing

![Billing hybrid plans UI](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aiBoSgeQX7-eWq6v_feature-billing-hybrid-plans.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=3840)

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXv0MqNJQqH0YC_icon-hourglass.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=32)

Support invoice-based sales, subscription billing and self-serve checkout from one platform

![](https://images.prismic.io/paddle/aHLXvkMqNJQqH0YB_icon-checklist.png?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max&w=48)

Build flexible customer and subscription experiences with APIs, including seat management and mid-cycle plan changes.

> We don’t have to worry about new markets charging tax on software. We can accept more payment methods now – our checkout is almost self upgrading.
